research_packets.title: Decision-time integrity and usable source history
research_packets.question: Which exact source revisions and owner clocks can support each proposed historical or prospective claim?
research_packets.population: A source-readiness census of supported identities, dates, source families and coverage strata; not an outcome-selected ticker list.
research_packets.inputs: Data OS identities, immutable source generations, observation/publication clocks, adjustment basis, episode generations, current model-vintage records.
research_packets.controls: Late capture, same-date correction, current-only event discovery, missing sessions, renamed/reorganized security and unknown model vintage.
research_packets.method: Trace representative source-to-decision paths with explicit cutoff joins. Measure coverage without looking at protected strategy outcomes; map irrecoverable history to prospective-only use.
research_packets.decision: An approved evidence matrix specifying observed-as-run, PIT replay or diagnostic eligibility for each input/date; missing compulsory inputs block only affected claims.
research_packets.falsifier: Any declared PIT path depends on a current body, later membership, future label or unproven clock. Repair or exclude it before fitting.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Winner/loser and missed-opportunity attribution
research_packets.question: Which part of the pipeline most often destroys useful opportunity or introduces avoidable downside?
research_packets.population: A complete dated supported cohort with original decisions and all dispositions; individual winners/losers illustrate rather than define it.
research_packets.inputs: Nominations, suppressions, B1 relations, original board rank/visibility, availability, accepted publication, entry/management and outcome references.
research_packets.controls: Cohort/era separation; control-only V3 tape; no ticker-ever conversion substitute; unresolved joins remain counted.
research_packets.method: Build a layered failure decomposition before recommending a rule. Separate discovery, ranking, delivery, entry, management and common exposure. Quantify attribution uncertainty.
research_packets.decision: Select the next largest identifiable capability loss and its corresponding research/build edge; do not tune V3 from a pooled headline.
research_packets.falsifier: The diagnosis reverses under original-time joins or depends on hindsight-selected names. Return a measurement correction rather than a trading rule.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: High-recall expert union and independent origination
research_packets.question: Do additional registered nomination species reveal useful opportunities earlier at the same review burden?
research_packets.population: Frozen supported universe and source-defined observation times, including nominees that never originate B1 or never confirm.
research_packets.inputs: Exact TURN WATCH/TOI/Radar/Doors versions, source-native anchors, false/unknown trigger distinctions, history and liquidity coverage.
research_packets.controls: Incumbent nomination set; duplicate-expert ablation; equal review burden; rejected-species equivalence review.
research_packets.method: Compare new incremental episodes and pre-B1 sightings, time-to-first-useful-entry, coverage and adverse cases. Use B1-approved anchor/re-arm only.
research_packets.decision: Promote an observation or strategy species only for its separately supported claim; broaden the visible field without silently widening trade admission.
research_packets.falsifier: Incremental rows are late duplicates, illiquid cases or unproductive noise, or value exists only after future confirmation filtering.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Same-origin daily/multi-day/intraday entry timing
research_packets.question: When does earlier lawful observation improve the complete entry policy rather than just the surviving filled trades?
research_packets.population: Same original eligible episodes across early-lawful, slower-confirmation, pullback and cash policies; no eventual-confirmation selection.
research_packets.inputs: Registered bar anchoring, source/decision validity, first observable episode, quote/basis and geometry, declared fixed management.
research_packets.controls: Same episodes and exits; never-confirmers/no-pullback cases; latency and cost sensitivity; incumbent next-close convention disclosed.
research_packets.method: Date-weighted paired full-opportunity H10 proposal with H5/H15 supporting for this new study. Separate episode-clock and fill-clock results and dependence.
research_packets.decision: Identify a bounded species/timeframe policy worth qualification, with exact availability requirements; do not grant confluence waiver via adapter.
research_packets.falsifier: Apparent early-entry gain disappears when failures, no-entry, gaps or real latency are retained, or depends on provisional bars treated as final.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Group leadership, member selection and self-confirmation
research_packets.question: Does group information improve selection beyond the candidate itself and ordinary industry exposure?
research_packets.population: Candidate-date observations with supported point-in-time group membership/weights; current-only cohorts separately labeled.
research_packets.inputs: GMI leadership, breadth, concentration, peer-excluding-candidate returns, own-stock residual/relative behavior and source lineage.
research_packets.controls: Own-stock-only; industry-only; leave-one-out peer; common-date weights; singleton and overlapping-theme controls.
research_packets.method: Compare group allocation and within-group selection contributions on matched endpoints, then test incremental forecast/research utility.
research_packets.decision: Retain only measurable independent group information and its uncertainty; an attractive group visualization is not promotion evidence.
research_packets.falsifier: The candidate generates the apparent confirmation, or current membership/popularity/sector beta explains the entire lift.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Comparable earnings and expectations
research_packets.question: Which economic changes carry remaining opportunity after the information becomes usable and price responds?
research_packets.population: Predeclared ordinary-accounting operating-company event cohort; separate post-release, issuer-guidance and licensed-analyst constructions.
research_packets.inputs: Event revisions, comparable facts/periods/bases, guidance, EPS/share changes, contributor estimates where licensed, release/call/filing times.
research_packets.controls: Own-price; issuer change only; matched surprise; contributor composition and forecast rollover; same-coverage enriched versus base models.
research_packets.method: Separate operating mechanisms, expectations, price response and policy capture. Propose H42 primary, H21/H63 supporting; freeze definitions before outcomes.
research_packets.decision: Approve specific fact/expectation features and a supported event species, not a universal earnings-quality bonus.
research_packets.falsifier: Lift is driven by restatement, GAAP/adjusted mismatch, changed contributors, horizon roll, already-earned gaps or a handful of selected events.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Cycle proving-domain and economic-turn identification
research_packets.question: Which domain offers an interpretable, historically measurable economic recovery mechanism without choosing recent winners?
research_packets.population: Source-readiness candidate industrial capital goods/machinery; final universe selected by coverage/mapping criteria before return inspection.
research_packets.inputs: Vintage orders, backlog, shipments, inventories, production, issuer segments and failure histories; common definition changes documented.
research_packets.controls: Domain breadth and composition; inventory-versus-sales interpretation; latest-revised versus vintage evidence; sector distress is not recovery.
research_packets.method: Qualify economic-series and issuer mapping, then define observable filtered turn hypotheses and negative controls; no future-smoothed phase labels.
research_packets.decision: One admissible pilot domain with explicit coverage and falsifiers, or a documented alternative chosen by the same readiness rule.
research_packets.falsifier: Apparent turn exists only in revised series, coarse proxies, survivorship-selected names, or future-known cycle troughs.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Funding, dilution and original-equity recovery
research_packets.question: Can the issuer survive until recovery, and does the original shareholder capture value after financing?
research_packets.population: All eligible cycle issuers including dilution, debt stress, failed firms, canceled shares and reorganizations.
research_packets.inputs: Dated cash and obligations, restricted cash/facilities, debt maturity, maintenance needs, hedging and diluted-share/claim structure.
research_packets.controls: Simple cash/burn; enterprise-value recovery only; survival-only; full original-security terminal outcomes.
research_packets.method: Build explicit joint scenarios with financing proceeds already reflected in net debt; test incremental economic prediction and realized equity capture separately.
research_packets.decision: A source-backed solvency/per-share view and qualified features; scenario ranges remain assumptions until calibrated.
research_packets.falsifier: Recovery value vanishes for original shares, or outcomes improve only after failed firms and canceled securities are excluded.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Multi-head remaining opportunity and payoff timing
research_packets.question: Can separate payoff, adverse-tail and time-to-event forecasts improve decisions beyond stage labels?
research_packets.population: Strategy-specific origin and registered current-landmark cohorts; no mixing of horizons or repeated rows as independent observations.
research_packets.inputs: Source-qualified base/economic features, accepted geometry, costs, fixed-horizon and first-event labels with explicit censoring/missing states.
research_packets.controls: Stage/horizon base rates; regularized return/logistic models; simple discrete competing-risk model before high-capacity alternatives.
research_packets.method: Evaluate net/relative means, quantiles, severe-loss and coherent target/invalidation timing; calibrate each head on held-out dates and top-K cohorts.
research_packets.decision: Accept heads individually only where supported and useful; abstain on unsupported heads rather than force all fields into UI.
research_packets.falsifier: No incremental policy value, incoherent first-event probabilities, poor selected-cohort calibration or hindsight path ordering.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Ranking objectives and economic tradeoffs
research_packets.question: Which ordering best serves a declared review/entry task without compressing all strategies into one score?
research_packets.population: Exact same candidate-date-strategy-horizon populations; actionable and research purposes separately identified.
research_packets.inputs: Qualified features/heads, current availability references, workload limit and declared risk preferences.
research_packets.controls: Incumbent V3 control; strong linear/additive rank; grouped boosted ranking; same information and cost assumptions.
research_packets.method: Freeze query grain, relevance label, objective and primary top-of-list metric. Compare net value/coverage/tails and rank stability; separately calibrate probabilities.
research_packets.decision: An accepted ranking artifact and supported purpose; ranking margin remains a relevance score, not a probability.
research_packets.falsifier: Win comes from altered population, arbitrary post-outcome penalties, extra information, or turnover that erases gains.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Calibration, abstention and user-visible confidence
research_packets.question: Which forecasts remain reliable after top-K selection and across evidence coverage?
research_packets.population: Held-out strategy/horizon/coverage cohorts and meaningful adverse events, retaining unavailable outputs.
research_packets.inputs: Frozen predictions, calibrator vintages, proper labels, risk/coverage and selected-population information.
research_packets.controls: Uncalibrated model; simple calibration; base-rate/shrinkage; coverage-matched comparisons.
research_packets.method: Assess proper scoring rules, reliability, interval width/coverage, tail sample counts and selective risk/coverage. Avoid automatic conditional guarantees.
research_packets.decision: Expose only qualified heads and meaningful uncertainty; unsupported precision stays absent.
research_packets.falsifier: Pooled calibration hides top-K failures, abstention drops hard cases without coverage reporting, or rare-event N is inadequate.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Context routing and behavioral fingerprints
research_packets.question: Do specific mechanism-by-context interactions add value beyond a global model?
research_packets.population: Estimable predeclared context cells with permitted fingerprint mechanisms and appropriate name-disjoint evaluation.
research_packets.inputs: Dated macro/group context, stable source-backed behavioral features, prior allowed routing evidence.
research_packets.controls: Global model; partial pooling; broad priors; name/permutation controls and identical source coverage.
research_packets.method: Register one interaction hypothesis at a time under the existing conditioning protocol; shrink thin cells and inspect out-of-support behavior.
research_packets.decision: A bounded conditional feature/expert rule if it earns incremental evidence; no broad universal regime authority.
research_packets.falsifier: Performance depends on tiny cells, indirect ticker memorization, recent-expert chasing, or unestimable interactions.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Economic propagation and graph value
research_packets.question: Do dated economic relationships reveal incremental opportunity rather than popular-theme associations?
research_packets.population: Fixed candidate and source-eligible edge cohorts with direct/proxy distinction and historical validity.
research_packets.inputs: Existing GMI/supply-chain edges, source novelty, direction, event exposure and own/group price response.
research_packets.controls: No graph; sector only; own stock; degree/popularity; shuffled edges and shifted availability.
research_packets.method: Start with transparent relation features, then evaluate qualified temporal graph representations on the same record and budgets.
research_packets.decision: Admit only supported relation features or representations through existing evidence/model owners.
research_packets.falsifier: Lift disappears after degree, membership, source time or ordinary sector exposure controls.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Specialist and qualitative evidence economics
research_packets.question: Which ownership, flow, news and specialist families add independent useful information?
research_packets.population: Coverage-qualified same-date cohorts, with covered/uncovered groups separately retained.
research_packets.inputs: Existing lawful insider/institutional/congressional disclosures, analyst/news sources, options context and event lineage.
research_packets.controls: Base model; each correlated sibling; filing-versus-transaction clocks; duplication; source selection/coverage.
research_packets.method: Test one declared family increment at a time; preserve transaction type and data limitations; evaluate added inference/data cost.
research_packets.decision: Prioritize acquisition and integration only for a named incremental capability or qualified prediction benefit.
research_packets.falsifier: Effect is information duplicated elsewhere, late public disclosure, coverage selection, or unsupported inferred investor/government intent.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Execution realism, bars and latency
research_packets.question: Does opportunity survive the actual source-to-visible-to-fill path?
research_packets.population: Same eligible decisions with feasible quote/basis evidence; no retroactively favorable fills.
research_packets.inputs: Native completed/provisional bars, quote/NBBO clocks, spread, source/visible latency, geometry and session facts.
research_packets.controls: Next-close control; quote-side versus midpoint accounting; cost floor; no-fill and gap cases; actual fine-bar order only.
research_packets.method: Quantify sensitivity to declared latency/cost/fill assumptions; distinguish missing evidence from non-entry; measure capacity only under a separate adequate model.
research_packets.decision: A reproducible fill/cost convention appropriate to each claim and a bounded feasibility conclusion.
research_packets.falsifier: Results require same-bar knowledge, false limit fills, stale quotes, double/omitted spread or imagined intrabar sequence.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Tactical and earnings management
research_packets.question: Which holding/exit behavior preserves useful upside without forgiving failed theses?
research_packets.population: Entries frozen from qualified policies; tactical and earnings populations separate.
research_packets.inputs: Original thesis and policy, target/invalidation, current-landmark evidence, event timing, path risk and cost.
research_packets.controls: Existing management; fixed-horizon marks; same entries; separately registered entry-by-management interactions.
research_packets.method: Evaluate giveback, time stops, reset/re-entry, next-earnings handling and costs without hindsight horizon selection.
research_packets.decision: An explicit accepted management version with immutable legacy-plan handling.
research_packets.falsifier: Gain comes from tuning exit after outcomes, transferring losers to another sleeve, or unreachable intraday prices.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Cycle core/add and milestone hold
research_packets.question: Can milestone-aware holding retain genuine recovery while terminating impairment?
research_packets.population: Failure-inclusive cycle episodes and original-security records over predeclared long horizons.
research_packets.inputs: Economic milestones, funding schedules, identity changes, core thesis, tactical availability and path outcomes.
research_packets.controls: Unlevered fixed policy; tactical-only exit; hold-through-all; same initial episodes and claim-adjusted terminal outcomes.
research_packets.method: Test economic milestone/expiry/invalidation rules separately from tactical adds; keep allocation downstream.
research_packets.decision: A qualified core/add/exit contract or a narrower rejected/unsupported claim.
research_packets.falsifier: Policy mainly extends permanent impairment, averages down mechanically or benefits from survivor-only recovery histories.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Incumbent B4 policy calibration
research_packets.question: How should the existing registered B4 liquidity/gap study be interpreted and integrated without altering its evidence era?
research_packets.population: The immutable pre-B4 population specified by #7751; this work packet does not create or widen a trial.
research_packets.inputs: Accepted preregistration, owner disposition of duplicate labels, real decision-time basis/quote/open/ATR and later owner outcomes.
research_packets.controls: Existing C0/control cells and accepted duplicate-alias handling; no historical backfill; protected outcomes remain closed until allowed formal read.
research_packets.method: Resolve semantics and sampling/effective-N/non-inferiority/multiplicity through the existing owner, then consume lawful study results under that contract.
research_packets.decision: Support for separate policy adjudication, never automatic threshold promotion or extra N from identical cells.
research_packets.falsifier: Non-identifiable costs/coverage, Pareto domination, adverse tails without compensation, or post-outcome rule substitution.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Feedback, attention and alert usefulness
research_packets.question: Do user actions and alerts improve comprehension and follow-through without becoming circular alpha labels?
research_packets.population: Consenting entitled users and actual presented snapshots; financial outcome experiments kept separate.
research_packets.inputs: Owner-recorded exposure, list saves, reason/thesis actions where supported, alert event identity/delivery and source changes.
research_packets.controls: Position/exposure bias; duplicate/no-change alerts; persisted versus optimistic UI acknowledgment; existing alert behavior.
research_packets.method: Evaluate task success, useful return visits and alert burden. Keep click/save prediction outside trading-label authority.
research_packets.decision: An accepted product feedback/notification contract, not a model that learns to chase popular clicks.
research_packets.falsifier: Apparent engagement is caused by forced interruption, misleading actionability, duplicated notifications or unrecorded effects.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: High-capacity representations and model vintage
research_packets.question: Do sequence, large-model or high-dimensional representations add value under fair controls?
research_packets.population: Admissible input/model-vintage cohorts with adequate independent dates/cycles and protected final evaluation.
research_packets.inputs: Owner-qualified histories and texts; exact training/model versions; fixed source/compute budgets.
research_packets.controls: Competitive regularized baselines with intercepts; same feature access; name-disjoint and permutation; prospective frozen model where vintage unknown.
research_packets.method: Allow ambitious challengers in parallel but compare actual combined policy returns, calibration, latency and cost; audit extraction separately from forecasting.
research_packets.decision: A specifically qualified representation/head or a documented null; architectural novelty alone earns no authority.
research_packets.falsifier: Gains depend on modern model hindsight, weak baselines, unfair aggregation, memorized names or intolerable operating cost.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Feasible portfolio and correlated opportunities
research_packets.question: Does the set of signals remain useful under actual capital and shared-exposure constraints?
research_packets.population: Qualified signal streams across sleeves with overlapping issuer/group/time exposure; no user position mutation.
research_packets.inputs: Accepted forecasts/policies, costs, security identity, shared themes, and declared downstream portfolio assumptions.
research_packets.controls: Equal-opportunity versus feasible capital series; cash; concentration/overlap; single-sleeve and combined controls.
research_packets.method: Build the actual hypothetical combined portfolio series through existing Portfolio/Risk evaluation; never average standalone Sharpe ratios.
research_packets.decision: Honest portfolio-context and research evidence; any sizing/personalization authority requires separate acceptance.
research_packets.falsifier: Apparent diversification double-counts the same issuer/cycle or profit relies on unlimited overlapping capital and omitted costs.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Drift, degradation and safe model operation
research_packets.question: How do we distinguish broken inputs and delayed labels from genuine economic/model deterioration?
research_packets.population: Accepted model/source versions and natural production generations, with labelled outages and correction eras.
research_packets.inputs: Coverage, source clocks/basis, feature distributions, delayed outcomes, forecast revisions and served-generation receipts.
research_packets.controls: Source-failure simulations; unchanged market inputs; old accepted model; subgroup and selection changes.
research_packets.method: Predeclare review/withdrawal conditions and exact owner rollback semantics; do not auto-tune from recent losses.
research_packets.decision: Operational review and fallback rules with immutable historical decisions and tested ordinary refresh.
research_packets.falsifier: Monitoring reacts to unlabeled data failure as alpha drift, hides stale actionability or overwrites historical predictions.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: Later sleeves and instrument-specific expressions
research_packets.question: Which policy/event, dislocation, range, real-asset, defensive, short or options jobs deserve distinct qualified strategies?
research_packets.population: Mechanism-specific populations selected before outcomes; US first, later regional calibration deferred.
research_packets.inputs: Existing event/market sources, instrument identity, borrow or option quotes when relevant, rights and economic mechanisms.
research_packets.controls: Killed-equivalence review; stock-versus-option/instrument controls; session/currency/microstructure and feasible costs.
research_packets.method: Define one governed species contract per accepted job and rank its readiness; reject unsupported variants explicitly rather than copying EL coefficients.
research_packets.decision: A sequenced research disposition for each retained avenue; no automatic live launch, leverage or regional transfer.
research_packets.falsifier: Construction is a renamed killed rule or lacks sufficient instrument/data/economic distinctions.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

research_packets.title: End-to-end usability and decision comprehension
research_packets.question: Can the intended user complete the research-to-save-to-review job without mistaking evidence or control output for trade authority?
research_packets.population: Representative entitled personas, dark/light, EN/ZH, mobile/desktop, actual positive and difficult source states.
research_packets.inputs: Real source-bound snapshots, episode drawer, current refusal, save/readback and historical record.
research_packets.controls: Existing product; naive confidence badge; sparse/corrected/off-board/empty states; keyboard and screen-reader behavior.
research_packets.method: Predeclare tasks and comprehension errors; measure completion, risk identification, false-action interpretation, workload and field performance.
research_packets.decision: An accepted product experience at the advertised claim level, independent of any alpha result.
research_packets.falsifier: Users cannot distinguish strategy/horizon, research from entry, or save from position; important conditions are hidden or inaccessible.
research_packets.current_authority: Existing protocol/owner and current source law; this registry grants no admission/outcome access/dispatch.

decision_register.title: Source-session validity and revocation
decision_register.required_evidence: Current exact adapter and producer heads; actual emission/scheduling contract; accepted session and basis facts; next-session, late-emission, expiry, retraction and shortened-session cases.
decision_register.required_output: Accepted source/observed/valid-for/expiry/revocation semantics, or proof of genuine current-session qualified production. Return to existing #7581 finding5789777976 without duplicating review.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Relabeling prior data as today, removing equality without a replacement validity rule, or translating compact UNKNOWN into FAIL.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Independent expert anchors and episode admission
decision_register.required_evidence: Owner-native nomination and structural anchor; causal observation clock; exact identity and re-arm semantics; rejected-source/key examples; comparison with known killed species.
decision_register.required_output: Versioned accepted source adapter and anchor contract with immutable episode lineage, suppression reasons and no changed historical IDs.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Ticker/date surrogate episodes, future extrema, silent retries of immutable source keys, or parallel lifecycle store.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Real source histories and rights
decision_register.required_evidence: Exact usable dates, field semantics, vintage/correction lineage, coverage by original universe, delistings, publication/processing rights and source costs; data-independent domain criteria.
decision_register.required_output: Signed-off source-readiness matrix and branch-specific admissible data classes. Industrial capital goods is a Cycle readiness candidate, not a return-selected winning domain.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Current membership/event set backdated, guessed statutory availability lags, broad industry series relabeled granular subthemes, or assumed licenses.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Distinct strategy, entry and holding versions
decision_register.required_evidence: Frozen economic job, supported instruments, eligibility, horizons by role, exact owner facts, entry windows, invalidation and hold/review rules; unchanged legacy control.
decision_register.required_output: Accepted sleeve definitions and separate policy versions; new 1D/4H entry and ER/CC management cannot be inferred from the EL control.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Changing labels under the singleton definition, horizon-as-hold inference, confluence waiver in an adapter or retroactive strategy relabeling.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Durable user decision/thesis mapping
decision_register.required_evidence: Actual supported write/read APIs and schema ownership; account/list/episode/security bindings; local/cloud distinction; retries, corrected generations, readback and independent portfolio checks.
decision_register.required_output: Owner-compatible versioned mappings for Watch, Pass/reason, thesis/milestone and held-position links. Unsupported actions visibly remain unavailable until their owner exists.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: A new Prophet personal store, turning a watch into a position, local-only notes advertised as cloud saved or unverified optimistic success.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Economic margins, endpoints and formal-read law
decision_register.required_evidence: User economic loss/coverage budget independent of held-out results; declared primary endpoint and cost assumptions; permitted pilot variability/dependence analysis; all comparisons/horizons/peeks counted.
decision_register.required_output: Finite registered analysis with numerical minimum worthwhile gain/non-inferiority/coverage margins, uncertainty method, effective-information floor and read schedule before outcomes. Existing7751 remains separately controlled.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Nonsignificant harm presented as safety, 300rows treated as sufficient power, favorable horizon selection, duplicate cells credited as independent or unrestricted threshold search.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Source and model-vintage eligibility
decision_register.required_evidence: Data release/observed/correction dates; model training and selection vintage where knowable; held-out partition and retrieval/extraction semantics.
decision_register.required_output: Observed-as-run, point-in-time replay or retrospective designation for each study, with a prospective remedy when historical model knowledge cannot be established.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Date-filtered retrieval treated as proof modern model weights contain no future knowledge; masking alone treated as certification.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Fill, costs, latency and capacity assumptions
decision_register.required_evidence: Executable side or approved cost floor, first usable decision time, session/bar anchoring, limit-order evidence, halt/delisting treatment and measured/floor/unknown status.
decision_register.required_output: Versioned fill/cost contract and sensitivity tests; no capacity claim until actual position/liquidity assumptions are evaluated.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Same-bar known-close fill, touch-equals-fill, twice-charged spread, missing quote treated as zero cost or a stop assumed guaranteed.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Visual architecture and user comprehension
decision_register.required_evidence: Current shared components, design tokens and route inventory; dark/light EN/ZH1440/390 examples; empty/invalidated/degraded/uncertain states and user tasks.
decision_register.required_output: Accepted visual packet and task-based comprehension criteria, including experimental versus live authority and new-entry versus held-position distinctions.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: A third header/token family, CSS skin swap counted as both art directions, or attractive mocks treated as production proof.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Exact source custody, worker admission and independence
decision_register.required_evidence: Current operation/Attempt state, writer leases and effect uncertainty; original review carrier; eligible capability and budget; exact immutable packet.
decision_register.required_output: One admitted source-authoritative operation per unit, least-scarce capable route, qualified independent reviewer and durable return path.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: A plan mistaken for dispatch, replacing a STARTed/unknown effect, Fable default placement or raw provider-spawn fallback.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Release, telemetry and safe rollback
decision_register.required_evidence: Current production-path artifacts, entitlement and account matrix, actual ordinary refresh, version-compatible last-good state and user-action preservation.
decision_register.required_output: Accepted staged-release/rollback packet with declared freshness and field performance budgets; current quote-state reevaluation after any rollback.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: Serving a stale green entry card from last-good cache, destructive user-store resets, or CI green treated as acceptance.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.

decision_register.title: Final US capability and claim boundary
decision_register.required_evidence: All advertised US persona tasks, three initial sleeve dispositions, independent scientific/mechanical/product evidence, actual limitations and remaining scope.
decision_register.required_output: Explicit accepted launch claims and ongoing obligations. Failed research is rejected honestly; further sleeves/regions require their own accepted work and do not disappear silently.
decision_register.forbidden_shortcut: A research prototype called a complete flagship, fabricated positive evidence, copying US coefficients to other markets or hiding a promised missing capability.
decision_register.interpretation: Preserve substantive decision; historical staffing/reviewer text does not override current Chairman AGENTS, Web waiver or actual repository/release controls.
